videos.title: Hyderabadi Biryani Commercial Feast
videos.description: Ultra-photorealistic cinematic luxury food commercial featuring an ascending handi biryani bowl with volumetric steam, golden embers, and glowing 3D typography.
videos.technique: Uses a dynamic vertigo dolly-zoom and volumetric steam to emphasize the luxury dish.
videos.prompt:
NOTE: Attach or upload your own dish or product image along with this prompt for the best AI video generation result!

Duration: 10 seconds
Aspect Ratio: 9:16 vertical
Model: Flow AI Video Engine
Style: Ultra-photorealistic, cinematic luxury food commercial
Lighting: Deep dark night sky, glowing neon-amber and warm golden rim lights, dramatic volumetric smoke, floating glowing embers
Camera: Dynamic low-angle tracking shot, fast upward launch, smooth slow motion, cinematic product showcase

MASTER PROMPT
Create a 10-second ultra-photorealistic cinematic commercial for a premium [Product / Dish] bowl. The scene begins in a dark, glossy, futuristic environment. The steaming bowl launches upwards into a dark night sky with glowing spice embers and volumetric steam trailing behind. As the bowl hovers smoothly in the sky, glowing neon 3D text illuminates directly above reading: "[Brand Tagline] is the finest taste in the world".

SCENE BREAKDOWN
Scene 1 (0–3s) – The Launch:
Low-angle close-up of a premium, traditional handi-style bowl placed on a wet, reflective black surface. Warm golden neon lighting powers up; the bowl shoots vertically toward the sky with dramatic swirls of fragrant steam and floating saffron particles.

Scene 2 (3–7s) – The Sky Ascent:
The camera rapidly tracks the bowl as it soars through the dark, cinematic night sky in slow motion. High-detail textures of long basmati rice grains, tender pieces, crispy fried onions, and glowing spice dust catch the golden rim lighting.

Scene 3 (7–10s) – The Final Text Reveal:
The bowl hovers gracefully at the center against the cloudy night sky. Bold, glowing golden 3D typography illuminates directly above the bowl, finished with a subtle cinematic lens flare across the text.
videos.author: Marcus Vance

videos.title: Obsidian Noir — Luxury Fragrance Reveal

Model: Gemini 2.5 Video Generation Prompt
Duration: 12 seconds | Ratio: 16:9 landscape
Style: High-end luxury cosmetic commercial, editorial Vogue aesthetic

[CAMERA SETUP]
Macro probe lens at f/2.8, slow 360-degree orbital rotation at 120fps. Camera starts at 15-degree low tilt, slowly rising along the vertical axis of the flacon bottle.

[LIGHTING & ENVIRONMENT]
Deep charcoal matte environment (#0B0C10). Single high-contrast key light positioned overhead with soft diffuse diffusion bounce. High-intensity neon cyan and digital teal specular rim lights graze the bevelled edges of the obsidian flacon. Thin vapor mist rises from chilled surface.

[ACTION & TIMELINE]
0:00 - 0:04: Extreme macro of condensation droplets beading on etched dark glass, iridescent rainbow prism flares refracting inside.
0:04 - 0:08: Smooth continuous zoom out revealing geometric silhouette; a single concentrated drop of golden amber perfume falls and impacts calm surface with acoustic ripple concentric rings.
0:08 - 0:12: Logo and typeface emerge in elegant serif typography floating in dimensional space with soft glassmorphism reflection.
